entities.name: PMID:25443138
observations: Primary-cell study in severe asthma reported that miR-19a enhances bronchial epithelial-cell proliferation by targeting TGFBR2.
Primary human bronchial epithelial cells from healthy controls and mild/severe asthma patients were tested; assays included luciferase reporter, Western blot, and BrdU incorporation.

entities.name: MIR19A
observations: miR-19a was elevated in severe-asthma bronchial epithelial cells versus mild-asthma and healthy-control cells; its overexpression enhanced proliferation, while repression abrogated proliferation.

entities.name: TGFBR2
observations: TGFBR2/TGF-βR2 was supported as a miR-19a target by luciferase reporter and Western blot assays; suppressing miR-19a increased SMAD3 phosphorylation through TGFBR2 signaling.

entities.name: miR-19a epithelial proliferation
observations: In primary bronchial epithelial cells in the severe-asthma study, miR-19a enhanced BrdU-measured proliferation; miR-19a repression abrogated proliferation and increased SMAD3 phosphorylation through TGFBR2 signaling. Mechanistic support is from one study; retrieved record lacks quantitative details and seed-site mutation information.
